questions.text: What problem are you solving?
Who experiences this problem most acutely (customer persona)?
What is your one-line value proposition?
How big is the potential market (rough estimate)?
Why are you personally motivated to solve this problem?
What existing solutions or competitors are in the market?
What gaps or differentiators exist for your idea?
What technologies/tools are needed to build your solution?
What are the top 3 risks you foresee (technical/market/financial)?
Have you estimated a rough TAM, SAM, SOM?

acceptance_criteria: At least one unique differentiator identified

questions.text: Have you spoken to potential customers? (How many?)
What percentage confirm they face this problem?
Would they pay for a solution like yours?
What assumptions are you still unsure about?
Do you have any letters of intent (LOIs) or pilot interest?

acceptance_criteria: Documented validation that majority confirm problem relevance
Evidence of early willingness to pay or adopt

questions.text: Do you have a low-fidelity mockup/wireframe or clickable demo?
Have you tested usability with target users?
What feedback did you collect from prototype testing?
How many iterations have you made based on feedback?

acceptance_criteria: At least 5–10 target users tested it

questions.text: Does your MVP include the core feature set?
Is it functional and usable by real customers?
Do you have analytics/tracking in place?
Who are your first pilot customers?
What is the MVP cost structure and unit economics?

acceptance_criteria: MVP deployed to at least 5+ early adopters
Product solves at least one core pain point
Positive feedback indicating repeat usage intent

questions.text: What is the current retention/engagement rate?
What bugs or UX issues have been fixed?
Have you run any A/B or usability tests?
What metrics improved after iteration?
Do you have a feedback loop process in place?

acceptance_criteria: At least one iteration cycle completed
Documented improvement in key user metrics

questions.text: Have you launched publicly?
How many paying/free users are onboarded?
What is your customer acquisition strategy?
What are your CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) and LTV (Lifetime Value) assumptions?
What is your current monthly active user (MAU) growth rate?

acceptance_criteria: At least 100 free users or 10 paying customers

questions.text: Have you achieved repeatable sales or organic growth?
Is your tech infrastructure stable under higher load?
Have you raised external funding or built partnerships?
What expansion plans (new markets/features) are in place?
Do you have sustainable revenue/profitability?
Are acquisition offers or IPO preparations underway?
What long-term strategic options are being pursued (exit, IPO, continued scaling)?
Do you have a strong leadership team and governance structure?

acceptance_criteria: Clear strategic roadmap (exit, IPO, or sustained scaling)
